name: orbital-launches
title: Orbital Launches and Payloads per Year, 1957 to 2026
description: Orbital launch attempts per year since Sputnik in 1957, with successes and failures, by launching state, plus the number of payloads (satellites and spacecraft) that reached orbit each year. Aggregated from Jonathan McDowell's General Catalog of Artificial Space Objects (GCAT). 2026 is partial, to 19 November 2026.

sources.title: McDowell, Jonathan C., General Catalog of Artificial Space Objects (GCAT), Release 1.8.9, data update 2026 Nov 19
GCAT Orbital Launch Log (TSV), the file this dataset is built from

resources.name: orbital-launches-by-year
resources.title: Orbital launch attempts and payloads per year

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year of launch (UTC). 2026 is partial, to 19 November.

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: Orbital launch attempts from Earth (GCAT launch category O or D, outcome success or failure). Excludes pad explosions and aborts, which never left the pad.

fields.name: successes
fields.description: Attempts GCAT scores as successes (launch success fraction of 0.75 or more).

fields.name: failures
fields.description: Attempts GCAT scores as failures (success fraction below 0.75).

fields.name: payloads_to_orbit
fields.description: Payloads (satellites and spacecraft, not rocket stages or debris) carried on that year's launch attempts that reached Earth orbit or beyond, i.e. are not in GCAT's failed-to-orbit catalog.

resources.name: orbital-launches-by-state
resources.title: Orbital launch attempts per year by launching state

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year of launch (UTC). 2026 is partial, to 19 November.

fields.name: state_code
fields.description: GCAT state code for the launch (its LVState field), e.g. US, SU (Soviet Union, to 1991), RU (Russia, from 1992), CN, F, I-ESA, NZ. This is GCAT's own assignment and does not always match the rocket's builder or launch site: Electron launches from New Zealand count as NZ, and most Ariane launches, plus Soyuz launches run by Arianespace or Starsem, count as F (France).

fields.name: state_name
fields.description: Plain English name for the state code (added by this dataset).

fields.name: attempts
fields.description: Orbital launch attempts by this state in this year.

views.name: launches-per-year
views.title: Orbital launch attempts per year, 1957 to 2026 (2026 partial)
